verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API is structured as a gateway-agnostic event layer (Checkout event fired 'before calling your Payment Gateway', Sale event recording PostAuth) implying it can sit alongside any PSP/gateway rather than being tied to one processor's rails. However, there is no explicit documentation listing supported PSPs, gateways, or e-commerce platforms, nor independent confirmation of multi-stack interoperability. Missing for 10: explicit PSP/gateway compatibility list, platform integration docs (e.g. named e-commerce platforms), and third-party validation of running across multiple payment stacks simultaneously.
